summary: Silvercorp Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K with an early warning report regarding its acquisition of 15,000,000 common shares of Tincorp Metals Inc. as partial consideration for the Santa Barbara Gold-Copper Project acquisition by Tincorp from Silvercorp's subsidiary Adventus Mining. The shares were issued upon closing on May 13, 2026, increasing Silvercorp's beneficial ownership to 27.4% from 17.9%. The filing does not specify a price per share or premium. Silvercorp states the acquisition is for investment purposes with potential future increases or decreases. Regulated under Canadian NI 62-103. Watch for further stake changes or regulatory disclosures.
